  "notes": "Target requires blending pre-retirement and post-retirement mortality rates. The document provides explicit sample rates for Pre-Retirement (Table on page 62) but only describes the Post-Retirement table (Pub-2010) on page 61 without providing a sample rate grid. Therefore, the 'group_weighted' operation can only utilize the Pre-Retirement rates (Male/Female) weighted by the Active Member counts (Table 2). Post-retirement rates are excluded from the calculation due to missing sample data. The source rates are printed as percentages (e.g., 0.024) and the values_unit is set to 'percent' so the code converts them to decimals. Target ages 20-24 and 75+ have no source data in the document and will be empty. The 'Post-Retirement Mortality Rates' table (Table 1) is transcribed as archived evidence but not used in the derivation."
